description: This file defines the 'Trunc' class that provides a method for truncating numerical values to a specified number of fractional digits, including handling array inputs. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation module, specifically in the MathTrig namespace.

classes.name: Trunc
classes.description: A utility class for truncating numerical values, supporting scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the truncated value of the input, with support for array inputs by delegating to evaluateArrayArguments.
